cards.ex: After complaining of chest pains, he underwent a barrage of tests at the hospital.
cards.exUz: Ko'krak og'rig'idan shikoyat qilganidan so'ng, u kasalxonada bir qator tekshiruvlardan o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'plab tibbiy tekshiruvlar birin-ketin o'tkazilishi.

cards.ex: Getting the transplant in time was a matter of life and death for him.
cards.exUz: O'z vaqtida transplantatsiya qilish uning uchun hayot va o'lim masalasi edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda muhim, hal qiluvchi ahamiyatga ega bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: The doctor prescribed medication to help manage her high blood pressure.
cards.exUz: Shifokor uning yuqori qon bosimini nazorat qilishga yordam beradigan dori yozib berdi.
cards.uzDef: Shifokor tomonidan dori-darmonlarni yozib berish.

cards.ex: His weakened immune system was due to an underlying condition.
cards.exUz: Uning zaiflashgan immunitet tizimi asosiy kasallik tufayli edi.
cards.uzDef: Mavjud bo'lgan va boshqa kasalliklarga sabab bo'luvchi kasallik.

cards.ex: Surgical intervention was necessary to repair the damaged artery.
cards.exUz: Zararlangan arteriyani tuzatish uchun jarrohlik aralashuvi zarur edi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni yaxshilash uchun jarrohlik yo'li bilan davolash.

cards.ex: Thankfully, her cancer is now in remission after several rounds of chemotherapy.
cards.exUz: Yaxshiyamki, kimyoterapiyaning bir necha bosqichidan so'ng uning saratoni hozir remissiya holatida.
cards.uzDef: Kasallik belgilari vaqtincha yo'qolgan holat.

cards.ex: She experienced acute pain in her back after lifting the heavy box.
cards.exUz: U og'ir qutini ko'targanidan keyin belida o'tkir og'riqni his qildi.
cards.uzDef: Birdan paydo bo'ladigan va kuchli og'riq.

cards.ex: Managing a chronic illness like diabetes requires constant attention.
cards.exUz: Qandli diabet kabi surunkali kasallikni boshqarish doimiy e'tiborni talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq davom etadigan va davolash qiyin bo'lgan kasallik.

cards.ex: The recent health scare made him reconsider his lifestyle choices.
cards.exUz: Yaqinda bo'lgan salomatlik xavfi uni hayot tarzini qayta ko'rib chiqishga majbur qildi.
cards.uzDef: Salomatlik bilan bog'liq jiddiy tashvish, qo'rquv.

cards.ex: Eating healthy and exercising regularly helps to build up resistance to illness.
cards.exUz: Sog'lom ovqatlanish va muntazam mashq qilish kasalliklarga qarshi immunitetni oshirishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Kasalliklarga qarshi immunitetni kuchaytirish.

cards.ex: The accident resulted in life-threatening injuries.
cards.exUz: Baxtsiz hodisa hayot uchun xavfli jarohatlarga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: O'limga olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan holat.

cards.ex: Trying this new treatment is a shot in the dark, but we have nothing to lose.
cards.exUz: Ushbu yangi davolash usulini sinab ko'rish - bu ko'r-ko'rona urinish, ammo yo'qotadigan narsamiz yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Muaffaqiyatga erishish ehtimoli kam bo'lgan urinish.

cards.ex: Getting enough sleep can help ward off illness during flu season.
cards.exUz: Yetarli uxlash gripp mavsumida kasallikning oldini olishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Kasallikning oldini olish yoki tarqalishiga yo'l qo'ymaslik.

cards.ex: His condition took a turn for the worse overnight, and he had to be rushed to the ER.
cards.exUz: Uning ahvoli bir kechada yomonlashdi va uni tez yordam bo'limiga olib ketishga to'g'ri keldi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat yaxshilash yoki yomonlash tomonga o'zgarishi.

cards.ex: Surgery should be considered a last resort after all other treatments have failed.
cards.exUz: Boshqa barcha davolash usullari samara bermagandan so'ng, jarrohlik oxirgi chora sifatida ko'rib chiqilishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qolgan yagona yechim yoki variant.

cards.ex: The doctors are optimistic that she will make a full recovery after the surgery.
cards.exUz: Shifokorlar jarrohlikdan so'ng uning to'liq tuzalib ketishiga umid qilishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kasallikdan yoki jarohatdan so'ng to'liq sog'ayib ketmoq.

cards.ex: Crowded places can be a breeding ground for infectious diseases.
cards.exUz: Odamlar gavjum joylar yuqumli kasalliklar uchun ko'payish joyi bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Mikroblar, kasalliklar tez tarqaladigan joy.

cards.ex: She put on a brave face, even though she was terrified of the procedure.
cards.exUz: U protseduradan juda qo'rqsa ham, jasur ko'rinishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Qo'rquvni yashirib, xursand bo'lib ko'rinish.

cards.ex: He seemed to be recovering well, but then he had a relapse.
cards.exUz: U yaxshi tuzalayotgandek edi, lekin keyin u qayta kasallandi.
cards.uzDef: Sog'aygandan keyin kasallikning qayta paydo bo'lishi.

cards.ex: I think I'm coming down with something; I have a sore throat.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, men kasal bo'lib qolyapman; tomoq og'riyapti.
cards.uzDef: Kasallik yuqtirib olmoq, kasal bo'lib qolmoq.

cards.ex: The stress of the job took a heavy toll on his health.
cards.exUz: Ishdagi stress uning sog'lig'iga og'ir ta'sir qildi.
cards.uzDef: Juda salbiy ta'sir, zarar.

cards.ex: After several tests, she was finally given the all-clear by her doctor.
cards.exUz: Bir nechta tekshiruvlardan so'ng, nihoyat shifokori unga ruxsat berdi.
cards.uzDef: Kasallik yo'qligi haqida ma'lumot olmoq.

cards.ex: He was at death's door with pneumonia, but he pulled through.
cards.exUz: U pnevmoniya bilan o'lim yoqasida edi, lekin u tuzalib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: O'lishga yaqin, juda og'ir ahvolda.

cards.ex: Even though the odds were against him, he still had a fighting chance.
cards.exUz: Garchi imkoniyatlar unga qarshi bo'lsa ham, u hali ham kurashish imkoniyatiga ega edi.
cards.uzDef: Muaffaqiyatga erishish uchun ozgina, ammo mavjud imkoniyat.

cards.ex: His surgery was touch and go for a few hours, but he stabilized.
cards.exUz: Uning operatsiyasi bir necha soat davomida xavfli edi, ammo uning ahvoli barqarorlashdi.
cards.uzDef: Natija noma'lum, vaziyat xavfli.

cards.ex: She's the picture of health after taking up yoga and healthy eating.
cards.exUz: U yoga bilan shug'ullangandan va sog'lom ovqatlangandan so'ng juda sog'lom ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Juda sog'lom va baquvvat ko'rinish.

cards.ex: Your body needs rest to fight off the infection.
cards.exUz: Tanangiz infektsiyaga qarshi kurashish uchun dam olishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kasallik yoki infektsiyaga qarshi kurashmoq.

cards.ex: He's still in the hospital, but the doctors say he's out of the woods.
cards.exUz: U hali ham kasalxonada, ammo shifokorlar uning xavfdan o'tganini aytishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin, xavfli vaziyatdan o'tib ketgan.

cards.ex: She's been putting on weight since she stopped exercising.
cards.exUz: U mashq qilishni to'xtatganidan beri vazn orttirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Tana vaznini oshirmoq.

cards.ex: After the diagnosis, she faced a barrage of medical tests.
cards.exUz: Tashxis qo'yilgandan so'ng, u ko'plab tibbiy testlarga duch keldi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p miqdordagi narsalar, ayniqsa savollar yoki tanqidlar ketma-ketligi.
